body.skin-vector-legacy {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top, rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.12), transparent 32%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #0c1017 0%, #0f131b 100%);
  color: #ece4d2;
  font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
}

body.skin-vector-legacy::before {
  content: "";
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 20% 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), transparent 24%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 8%, rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.08), transparent 22%);
  z-index: -1;
}

#mw-page-base,
#mw-head-base {
  display: none;
}

#mw-head {
  background: rgba(12, 15, 21, 0.88);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

#mw-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(16, 19, 26, 0.98), rgba(12, 15, 21, 0.98));
  border-right: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
}

#p-logo {
  padding: 1.5rem 1rem 0.75rem;
}

#p-logo a {
  background: none !important;
  text-indent: 0;
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  color: #f6ecd7;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

#p-logo a::before {
  content: "Controle Online";
  display: block;
}

#p-logo a::after {
  content: "Central de Ajuda";
  display: block;
  color: #d7b15a;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  margin-top: 0.25rem;
}

#content {
  background: rgba(16, 19, 27, 0.92);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
  margin-top: 1.25rem;
  padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.mw-body {
  color: #efe7d7;
}

.mw-body h1,
.mw-body h2,
.mw-body h3,
.mw-body h4 {
  font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  color: #f6ecd7;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

a {
  color: #d7b15a;
}

a:hover {
  color: #ffd66b;
}

#mw-panel .portal {
  margin: 0 10px 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border-radius: 18px;
}

#mw-panel .portal h3 {
  color: #f0bf57;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}

#mw-panel .portal .body ul li a {
  color: #efe7d7;
}

#mw-panel .portal .body ul li a:hover {
  color: #ffd66b;
}

#p-personal,
#p-views,
#p-cactions,
#p-namespaces,
#p-variants {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

.vector-menu-tabs .vector-menu-heading {
  color: #f1e6d1;
}

.vector-menu-tabs .selected > a,
.vector-menu-tabs .selected > span {
  color: #ffd66b;
  border-bottom-color: #f0bf57;
}

#p-search .vector-search-box-input {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #f6ecd7;
}

#p-search .vector-search-box-icon svg,
#p-search .vector-search-box-searchbutton svg {
  fill: #d7b15a;
}

.wikitable {
  background: #1a1e29;
  color: #efe7d7;
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 18px;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

.wikitable th {
  background: rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.14);
  color: #f6ecd7;
}

.wikitable td,
.wikitable th {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.gallerybox {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 18px;
}

.gallerytext {
  color: #efe7d7;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.mw-footer {
  margin-top: 2rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  color: #aab2c2;
}

.mw-footer a {
  color: #d7b15a;
}

body.page-Página_principal #firstHeading,
body.page-Project #firstHeading {
  display: none;
}

.co-hero {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  justify-items: start;
  margin: 1rem 0 1.5rem;
  padding: 2rem 2rem 1.75rem;
  border-radius: 26px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.18);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.18), transparent 28%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(28, 32, 44, 0.98), rgba(17, 20, 29, 0.98));
  box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

.co-hero--centered {
  justify-items: center;
  text-align: center;
}

.co-hero--centered .co-hero-copy {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.co-hero--centered .co-hero-actions {
  justify-content: center;
}

.co-hero--compact {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

.co-brand-logo {
  margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.co-brand-logo img {
  display: block;
  width: min(100%, 320px);
  height: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 16px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18));
}

.co-kicker {
  color: #d7b15a;
  font-size: 0.74rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.28em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.co-hero-title {
  color: #f6ecd7;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
  line-height: 0.95;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 0.85rem;
}

.co-hero-copy {
  max-width: 56rem;
  margin: 0;
  color: #d8dce5;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.co-hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-top: 1.35rem;
}

.co-hero-actions a,
.co-mini-links a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-height: 46px;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.15rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
  color: #f4ead9 !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.co-hero-actions a {
  min-width: 180px;
}

.co-hero-actions a:hover,
.co-mini-links a:hover {
  color: #fff2c7 !important;
  border-color: rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.45);
  background: rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.08);
}

.co-hero-actions a:nth-child(1) {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f0bf57, #d7a93d);
  color: #1d1604 !important;
  border-color: rgba(255, 221, 123, 0.3);
}

.co-hero-actions a:nth-child(1):hover {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffd66b, #e0b43c);
  color: #1d1604 !important;
}

.co-hero-actions a:nth-child(3) {
  border-color: rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.45);
  background: transparent;
  color: #f0bf57 !important;
}

.co-grid {
  display: grid;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.co-shell {
  max-width: 1220px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.25rem 2rem;
}

.co-home-shell,
.co-project-shell {
  max-width: 1240px;
}

.co-grid-apps {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.co-grid-featured {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
}

.co-link-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.75rem;
}

.co-card {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 22px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(29, 33, 45, 0.98), rgba(18, 21, 30, 0.98));
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

.co-card img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
}

.co-card-body {
  padding: 1rem 1rem 1.05rem;
}

.co-card-title {
  color: #f6ecd7;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.co-card-label {
  color: #d7b15a;
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
}

.co-card-copy {
  color: #cad1df;
  line-height: 1.55;
  font-size: 0.94rem;
}

.co-mini-links {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 0.6rem;
}

.co-mini-links a {
  min-height: 42px;
  padding: 0.6rem 0.85rem;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.co-card-app:hover,
.co-card-feature:hover,
.co-link-item:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: rgba(215, 177, 90, 0.22);
}

.co-card-app,
.co-card-feature,
.co-link-item {
  transition: transform 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease;
}

.co-link-item {
  padding: 0.95rem 1rem;
  border-radius: 18px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
}

.co-link-item a {
  color: #f4ead9;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.co-link-item a:hover {
  color: #ffd66b;
}

.co-footer-note {
  margin-top: 1.5rem;
  padding-top: 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
  text-align: center;
  color: #b8bdca;
}

/* Brand and mobile refinements layered over the imported theme. */
body.skin-vector-legacy {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.16), transparent 28%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%, rgba(240, 191, 87, 0.08), transparent 24%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, #08111d 0%, #0c1522 100%);
}

#mw-head {
  background: rgba(8, 13, 21, 0.9);
  border-bottom-color: rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.18);
}

#mw-panel {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12, 18, 28, 0.98), rgba(8, 13, 22, 0.98));
}

.mw-body {
  color: #e9eef6;
}

#content {
  border-color: rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.2);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.38);
}

.co-hero {
  border-color: rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.24);
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.22), transparent 30%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 0%, rgba(240, 191, 87, 0.12), transparent 26%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18, 27, 43, 0.98), rgba(10, 15, 23, 0.98));
}

.co-kicker,
.co-card-label {
  color: #3c6ca9;
}

.co-btn-primary {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #5e90d1, #3c6ca9);
  color: #ffffff !important;
  border-color: rgba(115, 158, 217, 0.45);
}

.co-btn-primary:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #6ea0df, #4678b8);
}

.co-btn-outline {
  border-color: rgba(240, 191, 87, 0.42);
  background: rgba(240, 191, 87, 0.06);
  color: #fff3c4 !important;
}

.co-card {
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(24, 31, 43, 0.98), rgba(14, 19, 28, 0.98));
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
}

.co-card:hover {
  border-color: rgba(60, 108, 169, 0.3);
}

.co-brand-logo img {
  max-width: 320px;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  #mw-panel {
    display: none;
  }

  #mw-head {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 20;
  }

  #content {
    margin: 0.75rem;
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .co-shell {
    padding: 1rem;
  }

  .co-hero {
    padding: 1.15rem;
    border-radius: 22px;
  }

  .co-hero-actions {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .co-hero-actions a {
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    width: 100%;
  }

  .co-grid-apps,
  .co-grid-featured {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .co-link-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .co-card-copy {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }

  .co-card-media {
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  #content {
    margin: 0.5rem;
  }

  .co-hero-title {
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 10vw, 2.7rem);
  }

  .co-hero-copy {
    font-size: 0.98rem;
  }

  .co-grid-apps {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .co-grid-featured,
  .co-link-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .co-mini-links {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .co-hero-actions a {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .co-card-app .co-card-copy,
  .co-card-feature .co-card-copy {
    display: none;
  }

  .co-card-body {
    padding: 0.8rem 0.85rem;
  }

  .co-section {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .co-card-media {
    aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
  }

  .co-card {
    border-radius: 18px;
  }

  .co-link-item {
    padding: 0.9rem 0.95rem;
  }
}
